posts.post:
most people are terrified of wearing clothes that actually fit their body.

we’ve all been conditioned to prefer the baggy safety blanket.

why do so many brands think a garment needs twelve buttons to be 'premium'?

it’s just more things to break.

the specific peace of mind that comes from knowing your outfit is fully wrinkle-resistant before a long flight.

i never travel in anything else.

spent three days debating the sleeve length on our next knit.

a half-inch difference changes the entire silhouette of the arm.
